description: Which open-weight LLMs fit this GPU: every model in list_models checked at one quantisation and context, with a recommended everyday model (the biggest class that fits with room for context at conversational speed), the largest that fits, the best at Q8 and the first out of reach. GPU: a name or id from list_gpus, or vram_gb for any other card.

apple_silicon.description: vram_gb is Apple unified memory; the GPU can use about 75% of it by default.

bandwidth_gb_s.description: Memory bandwidth from the maker's spec, GB/s, for a speed ceiling.

context.description: Tokens held in context: prompt plus conversation.

gpu.description: A GPU from list_gpus (id or name, e.g. "rtx-4090", "4090" or "M4 Max").

quant.description: Weight quantisation: fp16 (FP16 / BF16), q8 (Q8_0), q6 (Q6_K), q5 (Q5_K_M), q4 (Q4_K_M), q3 (Q3_K_M). q4 is the common default.

vram_gb.description: Memory of a card not in list_gpus, GB. For a Mac, its unified memory with apple_silicon: true.

name: what_fits
title: What fits my GPU?
